questions.question: When God told Moses and Aaron how to prepare the red heifer, where was it to be slaughtered?
In God's law about the red heifer, what did the priest throw onto the burning heifer?

answers.text: Cedar wood with hyssop and scarlet wool
Olive oil with frankincense and salt
Acacia wood with incense and linen

questions.question: God told Moses the water made from the red heifer's ashes was for what purpose?
Under God's law through Moses, how did a person who touched a dead body become clean again?

answers.text: He purified himself with the water on the third and seventh days
He offered a lamb at the Tent of Meeting on the seventh day
He stayed outside the camp for the full month after
